mapping: export_positions.py reindexes annotation root_id by Completeness_783.csv index; export_graph.py writes graph root IDs in that same order. Both scripts pinned and vendored. Metadata IDs are read from the existing WASM graph.
projection: Representative pos_x/pos_y normalized to uint16; fly left displayed left, dorsal up. Not neuron morphology or a 3D brain.
activity: Static anatomy; gold applied input Hz; cyan existing sampled output neuron Hz from response.raw. Whole-network spike totals use response.spikes. No fabricated full-brain per-neuron activity.
